stem: Students found a rock with fossils in a dry streambed. Which question can MOST LIKELY be answered by identifying the fossils in the rock?

options.label: A
options.text: How deep was the water millions of years ago where the fossils are located?

options.label: B
options.text: What types of organisms now live in the stream when it rains hard and fills with water?

options.label: C
options.text: What was the environment like millions of years ago in the area of the dry streambed?

options.label: D
options.text: How many different organisms are now living in the area of the dry streambed?
